en.short: Two-wheel robot up to 150 g with a vertical spinning blade. Enclosed arena only.
en.lead: Two-wheel combat robot up to 150 g with a vertical spinner driven by a BE1806 brushless motor. Two N20 gear motors drive it through a Malenki Nano; the weapon has its own ZTW Mantis Slim speed controller. The blade is printed, the PETG body takes about two hours. A spinning weapon is dangerous – only power it up in an enclosed arena with a working failsafe.
